args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west) failed health checks in all regions, with an error rate of ~18%. SRE rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback completed in all three regions; post-rollback the service is healthy with error rate back to ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation by the service team.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** to **v2.3.0**, the most recent previously healthy release, across all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: service is now healthy with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression is still unknown — the incident notes that follow-up investigation is needed before re-attempting that release.
